title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang pledges $2 billion for Europe, $250 million in compute for UK safety labs
text:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced $2 billion in European investments and new stakes in French startups like Doctolib and Entalpic. The UK gets $250 million in compute for AI agent safety and security research. Huang pitched open-weight models as Europe's way to close the AI gap.
The article Nvidia's Jensen Huang pledges $2 billion for Europe, $250 million in compute for UK safety labs appeared first on The Decoder.
